acceptanceCriteria: Boundary and worklist resolve the cited test file at the reviewed commit, with an explicit reason when that commit is unavailable.
Writing an obligation cite with an unknown label is refused with a named code.
The classifier's recognised test-file patterns are configurable or the closed set is documented with a NOT_PRODUCED reason for other layouts.
The two unlinked TOL requirements from PR #1203's dogfood-check are identified and linked or justified.
body: Limits retained by the V1-1913/V1-1915 lane (PR #1203, head 307025bb7, TOL-V0-079..088): (1) `obligations boundary` and the worklist read the test repository at HEAD, not at the commit the review was recorded against; (2) cite labels are not validated when written; (3) the test-file classifier is a closed naming heuristic (TOL-V0-083); (4) worklist rank keys are a fixed set (priority, nearest, age). Also: dogfood-check on that change reported 2 of 11 requirements unlinked without the lane identifying which.
title: Obligations boundary/worklist: read the test repository at the reviewed commit, validate cite labels, widen classifier and rank keys
